en.gameDesc: Prove binomial identities using block walking arguments, Pascal's triangle, the binomial theorem, and Vandermonde's identity.

af.gameDesc: Bewys binomiale identiteite deur blokstap-argumente, Pascal se driehoek, die binomiale stelling, en Vandermonde se identiteit te gebruik.

zu.gameDesc: Fakazela ubunikazi be-binomial usebenzisa ama-arguments okuhamba ngamabhulokhi, unxantathu kaPascal, isithiyo se-binomial, nobunikazi bukaVandermonde.
